root_idea.summary: The root centers on fastening, twisting, or enclosing one thing with another, alongside a distinct branch denoting an allotted share, especially of water.
root_idea.development: The twisting of rope develops into attachment and encircling objects around the neck, then into marking, imposing, or assuming a lasting burden. A separate branch denotes a portion or scheduled allotment of water; the sense of keys or treasuries is associated with securing, containing, and controlling what is held.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Distinct Quran-attested plural nominal form; the supplied lexical evidence gives several possible singular sources, so the plural citation is retained.
Quran-attested plural of the securely supported citation form قِلَادَةٌ.

senses.definition: Keys; in the Quranic expression, the keys or treasuries of the heavens and the earth, signifying divine possession, preservation, and control over them.
senses.usage_conditions: Occurs in لَهُ مَقَالِيدُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ. The expression is interpreted literally as keys, or figuratively as treasuries and the means by which all things are opened, secured, and governed; these interpretations converge on divine authority over the universe.

senses.definition: A garland or neck ornament placed on an animal designated for sacrifice, serving as an identifying mark.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic plural قَلَائِدُ refers to garlands placed on sacrificial animals within the sacred-rite context; the sense is a literal object hung around the animal's neck.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To twist, wind, or wreath one thing around another; especially to twist a rope, or to make and twist a slender piece of iron onto another piece.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The same literal image is used figuratively of an old man's judgment when age has weakened it so that his opinion is no longer regarded.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a fever to seize or attack someone recurrently.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported of fever that returns every day.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To irrigate growing crops.
To collect and pour liquid into a receptacle, including water, milk, clarified butter, or beverage; hence, to take a beverage or wine into the belly, to drink.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The collecting sense applies to transferring liquid into a tank or skin; the drinking use is expressed with a beverage entering the belly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put a necklace or collar around someone or an animal's neck, or to hang a sword from a person's neck or shoulder by its suspensory strap.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object may be a neck ornament, a marker, or a sword suspended by its belt; the Quranic sacrificial-animal application is represented separately under the Quranic form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To invest someone with an office or administrative authority; also, to confer a lasting badge of favor upon him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a figurative extension of placing something around the neck as a lasting sign or charge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Following another person's statement or action as authoritative without examining the proof, firmly believing that person to be correct.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A religious or intellectual figurative use, conceived as making another person's view a collar fastened around one's neck.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To oblige, constrain, or impose an affair upon someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative causative construction with an affair or task as the imposed object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To satirize or stigmatize someone with a lasting mark of disgrace.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The disgrace is conceived as something fastened to the person and not easily removed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the sea to drown or engulf people by closing over and covering them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the sea overwhelming a large number of people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put a necklace or similar object around one's own neck, or to hang a sword from one's neck or shoulder.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reflexive Form V construction describes self-adornment or self-suspension.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become invested with an office or administrative authority.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative use derived from wearing something as a lasting sign or charge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take an affair upon oneself, undertake it, or impose it upon oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Equivalent in the cited usage to committing oneself to an obligation or undertaking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A single strand or twist of a rope; also a bracelet of a corresponding twisted form.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The bracelet use is compared with the twisted strand of a rope.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The day on which an intermittent or quartan fever returns; also, a person attacked by such a fever on its recurring day.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may denote the recurring day itself or, according to one attestation, the person afflicted on that day.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The caravans travelling from Mecca to Jeddah.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized usage reported for the plural form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Irrigation or an allotted, scheduled turn of watering; also regular rain or watering supplied at appointed intervals.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to irrigating crops, to the day assigned for irrigation, to periodic rain, and to regularly scheduled watering of animals or palm trees.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A portion or allotted share of water; a draught of water.
The management or charge of an affair entrusted to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative construction in which one's affair is committed to another person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The dregs or sediment of clarified butter; also a mixture of dates and parched barley or wheat meal used in clarifying butter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized food-preparation term, also identified with قِشْدَةٌ or كُدَادَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The anatomical part where the moustaches divide, at the partition between the two nostrils.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare anatomical usage, also reported with several variant names.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A twisted rope.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Nominal description of the completed twisted object, distinct from the Form I action of twisting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A necklace, collar, or similar object that is put around and surrounds a neck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for a neck ornament or collar on a person or animal; its plural is قَلَائِدُ. The specialized Quranic sacrificial-marking use is listed separately.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Verses or poems that endure and remain throughout time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative plural use, likening lasting poetry to something permanently fastened.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lasting badge or continuing obligation of favor and acknowledgment; in an opposed use, an enduring badge of disgrace.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative uses describe a favor or stigma as something fastened around a person and not readily removed; the positive sense is reported as more common.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A certain asterism.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized astronomical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A reported variant term for the irrigation portion or watering allotment called قِلْدٌ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited reading is explicitly uncertain and may reflect a scribal mistake in the source tradition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A key.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form is reported with dialectal and borrowing-related variation; its plural forms include أَقَالِيدُ and مَقَالِيدُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The control, disposal, or management of affairs entrusted to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of keys as instruments of access and control.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Means or affairs that have become straitened or difficult.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported figurative usage; the cited lexical authority notes that this application is not firmly established.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A crooked-headed stick or reaping-hook used to twist herbage or cut it for making ropes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The tool is associated especially with twisting cut herbage such as قَتّ into ropes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A repository, magazine, store-room, or treasury.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Its plural is reported as مَقَالِيدُ; this is a classical nominal distinct from the Quranic plural's broader interpretive range.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A twisted bracelet formed by joining or twisting together two bracelets of the قُلْب type; also a bracelet made of twisted silver.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized ornament term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The place where a necklace or collar rests, or where the sword's suspensory belt lies, namely the neck or shoulder area.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The definition concerns the bearing place of a neck ornament or sword strap, not the ornament or strap itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having a necklace, collar, or similar object put around the neck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Passive-participial use describing the person or animal bearing the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A horse that has outstripped the others and is marked with something around its neck to show its victory.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The neck marker identifies the winning horse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A chief or leader upon whom the affairs of his people have been imposed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative passive-participial use describing someone charged with communal affairs.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Reported variant irrigation term retained with its stated textual uncertainty.

cautions: مَقَالِيدُ is retained as a plural public citation because the supplied lexical evidence allows several possible singulars and also reports that it may lack a fixed singular.
The reported أَقْلِيدٌ irrigation form is textually uncertain and may reflect a mistaken reading; it is preserved as a qualified Classical meaning rather than silently omitted.
The Lane Quran citation for the keys expression is explicitly identified as Quran 39:63 and 42:12; no historical bracket notation has been converted independently.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: The unit lane-unit:qld:8844:g2:main preserves a reading that Lane itself suggests may be a mistake; it is assigned to cm-aqlid-irrigation with that uncertainty stated in its usage conditions.
